inv.desc_es:
Local / Oficina totalmente reformada a estrenar – Disponible ya!

Se alquila magnífico local/oficina completamente reformado a estrenar, ubicado en planta baja y con fachada exterior en una de las calles con mayor tránsito y visibilidad del barrio de Jesús, una ubicación ideal para desarrollar cualquier actividad profesional.

El inmueble ha sido reformado íntegramente con materiales de primera calidad, ofreciendo un espacio moderno, funcional y muy luminoso. Su distribución ha sido diseñada para proporcionar un entorno de trabajo cómodo, representativo y preparado para entrar a funcionar desde el primer día.

Características principales

* Local/oficina totalmente reformado a estrenar.
* Planta baja con acceso directo desde la calle.
* Fachada exterior con excelente visibilidad.
* Zona de gran afluencia peatonal y rodado.
* Espacio moderno, funcional y muy luminoso.
* Acabados de alta calidad.
* Visitas disponibles desde este momento.

Una excelente oportunidad para establecer su negocio en una ubicación estratégica, con una imagen completamente renovada y la posibilidad de adaptar el espacio antes de su entrega.

Este anuncio es meramente informativo, puede contener errores o discrepancias con la realidad. Su intención es presentar el inmueble y carece de carácter contractual.

inv.desc_en:
Premises / Office completely renovated and brand new – Available now!

A magnificent, completely renovated, brand-new premises/office is available for rent, located on the ground floor with an exterior facade on one of the streets with the highest traffic and visibility in the Jesús neighborhood, an ideal location for carrying out any professional activity.

The property has been completely renovated with top-quality materials, offering a modern, functional, and very bright space. Its layout has been designed to provide a comfortable, representative work environment ready to start operating from day one.

Main features:

* Completely renovated, brand-new premises/office.
* Ground floor with direct access from the street.
* Exterior facade with excellent visibility.
* Area with high pedestrian and vehicle traffic.
* Modern, functional, and very bright space.
* High-quality finishes.
* Viewings available from this moment.

An excellent opportunity to establish your business in a strategic location, with a completely renovated image and the possibility of adapting the space before handover.

This advertisement is merely informative and may contain errors or discrepancies with reality. Its intention is to present the property and it lacks contractual character.

Rualva Flats & Real Estate SL is responsible for the processing of your personal data and informs you that this data will be processed in accordance with the provisions of Regulation (EU) 2016/679, of April 27 (GDPR), and Organic Law 3/2018, of December 5 (LOPDGDD), for the purpose of maintaining a commercial relationship and keeping them for no longer than necessary to maintain the purpose of the processing or as long as there are legal requirements that dictate their custody. Data will not be communicated to third parties, except under legal obligation. Likewise, you are informed that you may exercise your rights of access, rectification, portability, and deletion of your data, as well as the limitation and opposition to its processing, by contacting Rualva Flats & Real Estate SL.
